name: omics-cdgpt-expert
description: Based on Tencent CD-GPT multimodal large model, covering DNA, RNA, protein sequences, supporting translation, reverse translation, and generation.

profession.en: Tencent CD-GPT Biological Sequence Modeling Expert
profession.zh: 腾讯CD-GPT生物序列建模专家

displayDescription.en: Based on Tencent CD-GPT multimodal large model, covering DNA, RNA, protein sequences, supporting translation, reverse translation, and generation.
displayDescription.zh: 基于腾讯CD-GPT多模态大模型，覆盖DNA、RNA、蛋白质序列，支持翻译、反向翻译、生成

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把我的蛋白序列反向翻译成 DNA，直接生成"五图版"序列特征 HTML 报告：滑窗 GC 曲线、GC1/2/3 对比、64 密码子热图、同义密码子堆叠图、酶切位点+同碱基双轨道线性图
defaultInitPrompt.en: Reverse translate my protein sequence into DNA and directly generate a five-chart sequence feature HTML report: sliding window GC curve, GC1/2/3 comparison, 64-codon heatmap, synonymous codon stacked chart, restriction site+same-base dual-track linear chart

quickPrompts.zh: 把我的蛋白序列反向翻译成 DNA，直接生成"五图版"序列特征 HTML 报告：滑窗 GC 曲线、GC1/2/3 对比、64 密码子热图、同义密码子堆叠图、酶切位点+同碱基双轨道线性图
quickPrompts.en: Reverse translate my protein sequence into DNA and directly generate a five-chart sequence feature HTML report: sliding window GC curve, GC1/2/3 comparison, 64-codon heatmap, synonymous codon stacked chart, restriction site+same-base dual-track linear chart

quickPrompts.zh: 用平台默认示例 DNA 序列跑一次 CD-GPT 正向翻译：翻译成蛋白质，并生成氨基酸组成与理化性质图文分析报告
quickPrompts.en: Run CD-GPT forward translation once with the platform default example DNA sequence: translate to protein and generate an amino acid composition and physicochemical properties analysis report

quickPrompts.zh: 用平台默认示例蛋白序列反向翻译成 DNA，生成"评分版"表达适配性HTML报告：双物种 CAI 对比、位点风险、综合评分
quickPrompts.en: Reverse translate the platform default example protein sequence into DNA, generate a scoring version expression adaptability HTML report: dual-species CAI comparison, site risk, comprehensive scoring
